message: composer.lock installs evil/x from a VCS repository (git file:///srv/evil/x.git), which depcurfew.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of evil/x, or set sources.git to "allow" in depcurfew.json

message: composer.lock installs evil/y from an archive on evil.example (zip https://evil.example/y.zip), a host depcurfew does not recognize, so it may come from a source depcurfew.json denies
fix: Check where evil/y comes from: if a Composer repository serves it, declare that repository in composer.json; otherwise lock it again from Packagist with composer update
